title: The Smallest Conv Stack Has the Second Most Parameters
subtitle: Trainable parameters of the three CNNs, rebuilt from the layer stacks in model_builders

legendLabels.emphasis: Emotion CNN, four conv blocks with BatchNorm

rows.label: ASL, 29 classes
rows.detail: Three conv layers, Flatten, Dense 128. 36-class version has 3,308,708

caption: The gesture network has one 16 filter conv layer, yet 2.1 million parameters, because Flatten hands a 64 by 64 by 16 map (65,536 values) to Dense 32. The deepest network, the emotion CNN, is the smallest because global average pooling removes that layer.
source: results/count_params.py, run under TensorFlow 2.21 on Python 3.12
